Currently, Yvette offers private practice coaching through her Profitable Private Practice group programs. This is her high-touch coaching program, and the best way to get personal access to her for help with starting, scaling, and expanding your practice.

In the Profitable Private Practice programs, Yvette takes you through her strategic trainings and custom process to start, scale, and/or expand your private practice and create the freedom, flexibility, and financial stability you deserve to have.
This includes providing feedback in our provide community during Live coaching calls via zoom.

When you purchase a product and can’t log in, there are a few options for what has happened:
1️⃣ You may have used a different email address for making the purchase than the one you're trying to login with (E.g. used your gmail instead of your outlook - this is common).
Please check your other email accounts for our email and login details, including your promotion or spam folders.
When logging in, please use the email address you received our emails from after your purchase.
2️⃣ Our confirmation email has gone to your spam or promotions folder (please check there first before emailing us 👀).
3️⃣ You may have made a small mistake when entering your email at the time of purchase (”.con” vs. “.com” - this happens somewhat often) or a spelling error in the address itself.
4️⃣ You forgot your password.
If you think you may have forgotten your password, go to bossclinician.com/login and tap choose the 'Forgot Password' option at the bottom to resend your password to the email linked to your account.
If no email arrives, enter all possible addresses you might have used.👇
If you have already checked your other possible email addresses and all spam and promotional folders, and you’ve tried to login with any of your alternate email addresses with no success...
It sounds like you may have made a small typo when entering your email at the time of purchase.
👉Please send me an email to hello@carolineflett.com with the following details:
“Hi, I purchased [PRODUCT NAME], and I’m having trouble logging into my account”. Here are my details:
Full name:
Email address: (or any other email addresses you may have used)
Date of purchase:”
We’ll get this solved for you! 😊
Caroline

The Profitable Private Practice Leap Accelerator
Your 12-week launchpad for starting your private practice with clarity and confidence.
This program may be right for you if…

✅ You’re a licensed (or pre-licensed) therapist still working full- or part-time and ready to finally launch your own private practice ✅ You’re overwhelmed by where to start—setting up, pricing your services, marketing yourself—and need a clear step-by-step plan ✅ You want weekly coaching, guidance, and templates so you don’t waste time Googling or second-guessing your every move ✅ You want to build a practice that reflects your values, supports your lifestyle, and actually brings in clients you love ✅ You’re new to business but excited to learn how to confidently attract clients, talk about your services, and position yourself online ✅ You want a supportive, empowering space where you're guided by a coach (Yvette!) who understands the mental health field AND business ✅ You’ve been thinking about going solo for months (or years!) and just need the accountability and structure to make it real

Think of this as your private practice launch toolkit—with coaching, community, and done-for-you business foundations to finally make the leap.
